Last Night’s Fun John Carty . . . Bb

Yep . . Bb. I’m not a fiddle player, but I suspect that he has tuned his fiddle up half a step. You’ll find players who do this . . . recording in Eb, Bb, etc. Something about the tone, also a history of playing with other instruments that were in those keys.
